cases.question: Flash flood watch for Webb County. Quantify population exposure and identify hexes with high social vulnerability and low community resilience.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    pop.population_7km,
    vul.psvi_score,
    fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n AS fire_stations,
    hosp.hifld_health_hospitals_n AS hospitals,
    (SELECT SUM(pop2.population_7km) FROM "EX_POP_001" pop2 
     JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON pop2.hex_id = h2.hex_id 
     WHERE h2.County = 'Webb County') AS total_population
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
JOIN 
    "EX_POP_001" pop ON h.hex_id = pop.hex_id
JOIN 
    "VUL_004" vul ON h.hex_id = vul.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire ON h.hex_id = fire.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hosp ON h.hex_id = hosp.hex_id
WHERE 
    h.County = 'Webb County'
    AND vul.psvi_score > (
        SELECT AVG(vul2.psvi_score) 
        FROM "VUL_004" vul2 
        JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON vul2.hex_id = h2.hex_id 
        WHERE h2.County = 'Webb County'
    )
    AND fire.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n < (
        SELECT AVG(fire2.hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n)

        JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h2 ON fire2.hex_id = h2.hex_id
```

    hosp.hifld_health_hospitals_n ASC;

cases.question: Severe flooding in Webb County. How does social vulnerability compound emergency response challenges during an active flood? Identify the highest-priority zones for swift-water rescue deployment.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    ROUND((hp.nri_coastal_flood + hp.nri_riverine_flood) * v2.sovi * v4.psvi_score * p.population_7km / COALESCE(s.hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n, 1), 4) AS priority_score
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
JOIN 
    "HP_FLD_002" hp ON h.hex_id = hp.hex_id
JOIN 
    "VUL_002" v2 ON h.hex_id = v2.hex_id
JOIN 
    "VUL_004" v4 ON h.hex_id = v4.hex_id
JOIN 
    "EX_POP_001" p ON h.hex_id = p.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" s ON h.hex_id = s.hex_id
WHERE 
    h."County" = 'Webb County'
ORDER BY 
    priority_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
SELECT
```

cases.question: Hurricane in Nueces County. Query FEMA base flood elevation data and storm surge depth grids to assess which roads will be inundated, then estimate power outage extent.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
    h.County,
    p.nri_coastal_flood,
    p.nri_riverine_flood,
    t.hifld_primary_roads_km,
    e.hifld_energy_plants_n,
    s.hifld_energy_substations_n,
    ROUND((COALESCE(e.hifld_energy_plants_n, 0) + COALESCE(s.hifld_energy_substations_n, 0)) * 0.75, 4) AS estimated_outage_impact
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
JOIN 
    "HP_FLD_002" p ON h.hex_id = p.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-TRANSP-PRIMARY_RD-L" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e ON h.hex_id = e.hex_id
LEFT JOIN 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON h.hex_id = s.hex_id
WHERE 
    h.County = 'Nueces County'
    AND (p.nri_coastal_flood > 0.5 OR p.nri_riverine_flood > 0.5);
```

SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
```sql
    ROUND(h.hurr_strike_rate_10y, 4) AS hurricane_strike_rate,
    ROUND(v.ve_ae_fraction, 4) AS exposure_fraction,
    ROUND(e.hifld_energy_plants_n, 4) AS power_plants_count,
    ROUND(s.hifld_energy_substations_n, 4) AS substations_count,
    ROUND(t.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p, 4) AS transmission_km,
    ROUND((h.hurr_strike_rate_10y * v.ve_ae_fraction * e.hifld_energy_plants_n), 4) AS risk_score
FROM 
    "HP_HUR_001" h
JOIN "HP_HUR_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e ON h.hex_id = e.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON h.hex_id = s.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" x ON h.hex_id = x.hex_id
WHERE 
    x.State = 'Texas'
    AND e.hifld_energy_plants_n > 0;
```

cases.reforce_sql:
SELECT 
    h.hex_id,
```sql
    h.State,
    h.County,
    ROUND(COALESCE(f.nri_coastal_flood, 0.0) + COALESCE(f.nri_riverine_flood, 0.0), 4) AS flood_risk,
    ROUND(COALESCE(hu.hurr_strike_rate_10y, 0.0), 4) AS hurricane_risk,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.nri_tornado, 0.0), 4) AS tornado_risk,
    ROUND((COALESCE(v.sovi, 0.0) + COALESCE(vu.psvi_score, 0.0)) / 2, 4) AS vulnerability_score,
    p.population_7km,
    ROUND(c.nri_cri_score, 4) AS critical_infra_score,
    e.hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n AS eoc_count,
    hif.hifld_health_hospitals_n AS hospital_count,
    ROUND((COALESCE(f.nri_coastal_flood, 0.0) + COALESCE(f.nri_riverine_flood, 0.0) + COALESCE(hu.hurr_strike_rate_10y, 0.0) + COALESCE(t.nri_tornado, 0.0)) * (COALESCE(v.sovi, 0.0) + COALESCE(vu.psvi_score, 0.0)) / 2, 4) AS compound_risk_score
FROM 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h.hex_id = f.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" hu ON h.hex_id = hu.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON h.hex_id = v.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" vu ON h.hex_id = vu.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" p ON h.hex_id = p.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "CR_001" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" e ON h.hex_id = e.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hif ON h.hex_id = hif.hex_id
WHERE 
    h.State IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
